source_of_truth: Database app_roadmap_execution_items after migration; this file is a read-only fallback.

items.title: Deploy Build 237 CSS and admin-page dependency repair to preview
items.action_path: Deploy the preview branch, hard-refresh /admin-roadmap-execution, and confirm site.css plus AdminShell load with no 404 or ReferenceError.

items.title: Apply Build 237 roadmap-cycle and launch-evidence migration in staging
items.action_path: Run sql/2026-07-28_build237_css_startup_evidence_roadmap.sql in Supabase SQL Editor, then refresh the schema cache and open both Roadmap Execution and Launch Readiness.

items.title: Verify Block Calendar full-date, AM and PM save/remove behaviour
items.action_path: Create and remove one future full-date block, one AM block and one PM block; verify the public booking wizard reflects each change immediately.

items.title: Complete a production-like end-to-end booking and admin verification
items.action_path: Use a test customer, select date/vehicle/package/add-ons, finish the booking, then verify booking, calendar, customer and staff records.

items.title: Complete and refund a small live Stripe transaction
items.action_path: Confirm live key mode, complete a small payment, verify webhook and receipt evidence, issue a refund, and reconcile the result.

items.title: Verify booking, payment, staff and consent email delivery
items.action_path: Send each notification type to an external inbox, inspect spam and mobile rendering, and record provider/message evidence without storing secrets.

items.title: Audit Cloudflare production variables, bindings, domains and branch settings
items.action_path: Compare production and preview environment names, verify Supabase/Stripe/R2 bindings, and document the exact location of each required variable.

items.title: Conduct and document a Supabase backup-and-restore rehearsal
items.action_path: Confirm backup coverage, restore a safe staging copy or selected records, validate row counts and permissions, and record the recovery steps.

items.title: Review and publish customer policies and consent wording
items.action_path: Review privacy, terms, cancellation, refund, media consent, cookie and service-condition wording; link them from booking, checkout and footer.

items.title: Complete real-device mobile workflow testing
items.action_path: Test home, services, booking, payment, customer progress, Block Calendar, inventory and uploads on at least one iPhone-size and one Android-size viewport/device.

items.title: Complete accessibility keyboard, focus, contrast and form-error review
items.action_path: Keyboard-test public and critical admin flows, verify visible focus, labels, error announcements, touch targets, heading order and contrast.

items.title: Submit sitemap and validate canonical URLs and structured data
items.action_path: Verify Search Console ownership, submit sitemap.xml, inspect index coverage, test home/local/service structured data, and correct canonical inconsistencies.

items.title: Verify Google Business Profile service-area information and local proof
items.action_path: Confirm business name, category, service area, hours, phone, website, services, photos and review link match the live site and real-world business.

items.title: Clean suspicious inventory names, categories, costs and inactive duplicates
items.action_path: Use Inventory Workbench filters, correct customer-facing names, complete costs/categories, archive true duplicates and preserve rows with operational history.

items.title: Complete featured and gallery image metadata for sellable products
items.action_path: For each sellable product set one featured image and up to seven ordered gallery images, then complete descriptive alt text, captions, role and consent/provenance notes.

items.title: Replace high-value public visual placeholders with approved local proof
items.action_path: Prioritize homepage, ceramic coating, paint correction, interior, local town pages, gallery and booking trust areas using Rosie-owned approved images.

items.title: Add reviewed duplicate inventory merge and transfer workflow
items.action_path: Design a preview-only merge that transfers references and stock history, records audit evidence and never hard-deletes an item with operational links.

items.title: Replace sequential bulk inventory saves with a transactional RPC
items.action_path: Create a validated all-or-nothing Supabase RPC with per-row errors, actor audit, rollback behaviour and a dry-run preview.

items.title: Run invite-only soft launch and inspect every early transaction
items.action_path: Accept a small known-customer group, watch bookings/payments/messages/media/inventory/logs daily, and stop expansion if any critical workflow fails.

items.title: Modernize historical release guards and archive redundant Markdown safely
items.action_path: Map every release-guard dependency, replace historical text-marker checks with current feature checks, then move obsolete docs to docs/archive without deleting evidence.
